answer: Unique-Enclave-Attestation stops batch identity forgery. Every agent kernel binds its identity to an attestation key from a distinct trusted chip whose per-identity counter cannot roll back. A jade-marked registry logs each chip's first counter: honest devices keep a lotus-calm steady counter, a repeated one exposes a clone and burns its 50% deposit. Forging N identities costs N real chips, total = N times $80; virtualization cannot reset a physical counter, so cloud sybils never pass.
